setup.evaluate: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button, a, [role=button]')].find(e => /^(reject|reject all|decline|decline all)$/i.test(e.textContent.trim()) && e.getClientRects().length); if (b) b.click(); return !!b; })()

(() => { const el = [...document.querySelectorAll('div, span, p, h2, h3, h4')].find(e => /live call/i.test(e.textContent) && e.children.length === 0 && e.getClientRects().length); if (el) { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); window.scrollTo({ top: r.top + scrollY - 150, behavior: 'instant' }); } return !!el; })()
